references.text: Moses gave land to the tribe of Reuben east of the Jordan, as part of the distribution to the two and a half tribes
The listing of Reuben's descendants by their clans, which forms the basis for the land allocation mentioned in Joshua
Moses describes how he gave the land east of the Jordan to the tribe of Reuben and the other tribes
Reference to the land given to Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh
Joshua reminds the tribe of Reuben that Moses gave them the land east of the Jordan
The tribe of Reuben is allowed to return to their inheritance land that Moses had given them
The tribe of Reuben had already received their inheritance according to their families
